title: Orsen and the Safehouse
author: Silas Dravenmoor
blurb: Ines Winterbourne, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
